notes.title: Notice regarding Additional Features
notes.notes:
[h1][b]ELYSION 1.1.0 Update Notes[/b][/h1]

[h2]・Added a RANKING page[/h2]
Added a page where you can check your rankings within the game. You can check your personal rankings through local rankings, and check your standing in the world through online rankings. Rankings can be sorted into different difficulty levels. 

[h2]・Added a GALLERY page[/h2]
You can check the Portrait Art and their Chibi-forms that appear during battle scenes. During battle, the chibi-characters aren't tpp big. You're able to zoom in on the chibi-characters in the Gallery. 


[h2]・Added changes to Options[/h2]
Previously, no matter what the homing level was for an Option, receiving damage brought down the level to 0. With this update, whne the homing level is higher than 1 and your unit receives damage, the homing level decreases by 1 level. 


[h2]・Added a VERY EASY MODE[/h2]
We received some complaints of EASY MODE being too challenging for some, so we decided to add a VERY EASY MODE. In VERY EASY MODE, your unit has 1.5 times the HP to your unit in EASY MODE. Enemy HP is 1/3 lower and Bomb's default stats are doubled, and Options numbers are always at MAX, with the homing ability also maximized. It will not decrease even after receiving damage. 
You can feel invincible when playing at this difficulty.

notes.title: Notice regarding Improvements for Usabilty
notes.notes:
[h1][b]ELYSION 1.0.1 update content[/b][/h1] 

・When ythe player unit approaches the top of the screen, the animation for the UI won't disappear, but will turn translucent.
・Providing localization for "Settings" and adding descriptions.
・Adding an option to remove story mode scenes during a mission. 
・Adding a feature to detect the user's language setting to determine the language setting for the game. 
・Adding a button in the title screen to show the game instructions. The instructions will be opened on another page.
・A PDF instruction manual will be downloaded to the Install folder. 
・Adding a button in the key configuration menu to restore default settings. 

We will be adding more updates in the future to make sure everyone continues to have fun with the game, so please stay tuned!!

notes.title: Notice about restoring key configurations to default settings
notes.notes:
"We have received numerous requests for a feature to restore key configuration settings. As th feature is not yet available, please use the following steps to restore your key configurations. 
Access the folder in which ELYSION is installed and please delete the file named ""_key_config"". This will restore your key configuration to its default settings. 

We are working on implementing a feature which will allow players to restore their key configurations in-game, but until then, please use the steps described above to manually restore them. "
